queries.query: Large language models for network operations NetOps configuration generation "LLM" "network configuration"
queries.rationale: Locate core papers and demos where LLMs generate network configs, intent-to-configuration, or natural-language-driven NetOps workflows.

queries.query: LLM-assisted configuration repair "configuration repair" "large language model" "network"
queries.rationale: Find work on LLMs or generative models used to detect and repair faulty network configs or outages.

queries.query: generate-validate-repair architecture "generate validate repair" LLM NetOps
queries.rationale: Survey architectures combining generation, deterministic validators, and iterative repair loops applied to network configs.

queries.query: formal network verification Batfish "Header Space Analysis" "network verification"
queries.rationale: Collect deterministic verification tools/methods (Batfish, HSA, Minesweeper) used as validators for configuration correctness.

queries.query: benchmarks LLMs for networking evaluation "NetOps" benchmark "AIOps" "network configuration benchmark"
queries.rationale: Identify existing benchmarks and datasets used to evaluate LLMs or AIOps systems in networking, and their limitations.

queries.query: validation and construct validity of NetOps benchmarks "construct validity" network benchmark
queries.rationale: Find methodological literature on benchmark validity, ecological/construct/external validity applied to NetOps tasks.
Locate work on LLM tool use, verifier-assisted correction, chain-of-thought and bounded iterative repair strategies.

queries.query: agentic AI/ autonomous agents for network management "autonomous agent" "network management"
queries.rationale: Survey agentic architectures that plan and execute NetOps actions, and safety/reliability controls used.

queries.query: safety and reliability of automated operational agents "AIOps" "safety" "reliability"
queries.rationale: Gather literature on operational safety, rollback, validation, and guardrails for automated operators (AIOps).

queries.query: evaluation metrics for NetOps correctness "reachability" "connectivity" "policy compliance" "misconfiguration"
queries.rationale: Identify concrete operational metrics (reachability, ACL correctness, policy compliance, performance impact) used to evaluate configs.

queries.query: simulators and execution environments for network experiments Mininet ns-3 containerized lab
queries.rationale: Find common emulators/simulators and testbeds used to execute or validate network configurations and changes.

queries.query: adversarial and robustness evaluations for LLM-generated code/configurations "adversarial" "LLM" "configuration"
queries.rationale: Locate adversarial testing approaches and robustness analyses for model-generated configs or scripts.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop vs fully autonomous NetOps interventions studies "human-in-loop" "automation" network operations
queries.rationale: Compare hybrid and autonomous approaches and their measured operational outcomes, trust, and safety tradeoffs.

queries.query: case studies: production incidents caused by configuration errors "misconfiguration" outage case study
queries.rationale: Collect real-world misconfiguration incident analyses to ground operational threat models and failure modes.

queries.query: program repair and synthesis literature relevant to config synthesis "program repair" "program synthesis" LLM
queries.rationale: Leverage methods and evaluation from program synthesis/repair (e.g., Codex/GitHub Copilot studies) for configuration generation/repair.

queries.query: metrics and statistical methods for evaluating paired model interventions "paired design" "bootstrap" "confidence interval"
queries.rationale: Assemble appropriate statistical methods for paired comparisons, uncertainty quantification, and failure-mode analysis.

queries.query: limitations of synthetic datasets for operational validity "synthetic" "ecological validity" network datasets
queries.rationale: Determine how synthetic task banks and emulated topologies may diverge from production and how to mitigate.

queries.query: best practices for reproducible LLM experiments prompt capture seeds logs "reproducibility" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Find guidance on experiment preregistration, prompt/version capture, seed policies, and artifact preservation for LLM studies.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference or journal papers (IEEE, ACM, SIGCOMM, NSDI, IMC, USENIX) and recent arXiv preprints with clear methodology
Tool or benchmark documentation (Batfish, Mininet, ns-3) when cited for verification/validation capability
Operator postmortems or authoritative industry reports relevant to configuration failures
Papers addressing LLM/tool-assisted generation, verification, iterative repair, or agentic NetOps workflows
Methodological literature on benchmark validity, reproducibility, and statistical evaluation applicable to NetOps studies
Works published or updated within the last ~6 years (2020–2026) prioritized; older foundational verification papers allowed
exclusion_criteria: Papers solely about general NLP tasks with no NetOps or configuration relevance
Unofficial blog posts or low-quality sources lacking verifiable provenance unless they are authoritative operator postmortems
Benchmarks that only test factual QA about networking (knowledge quizzes) without operational configuration tasks
Papers predating foundational verification tools where more authoritative modern sources exist unless providing historical context
Works that report model rankings on generic networking QA without analysis of operational correctness, verification, or failure modes
date_rationale: Prioritize literature from 2020–2026 to capture LLM-era methods and recent NetOps AIOps work while allowing older foundational verification and program-synthesis papers for background and mechanisms.
